_comment: Demo pocket off Notbigville: hub + four elemental rift mouths (basegame gates demo). Atlas pocket at (36,10) on earth_america.json.

rooms.title: Rift Nexus - Hub - Convergence
rooms.description: A chalk circle and four mismatched arches ring a shallow basin of still air. Each arch flickers with a different elemental hue; only some mouths are open at any moment.

rooms.title: Rift Nexus - Fire Mouth - Ember Throat
rooms.description: Heat ripples from a scorched stone arch. Ash drifts in a draft that smells like a forge left running.

rooms.title: Rift Nexus - Water Mouth - Brine Throat
rooms.description: A cool arch weeps condensation. The stone underfoot is slick with salt and tide-smell.

rooms.title: Rift Nexus - Air Mouth - Gale Throat
rooms.description: A pale arch hums with wind that never quite settles. Dust spirals in the opening like a held breath.

rooms.title: Rift Nexus - Stone Mouth - Cairn Throat
rooms.description: A squat arch of raw granite. The air is dry and the light flat, as if the room forgot color.
